description: This file declares the AudioTimeStretcher class, which buffers and transforms audio data using the WSOLA algorithm to stretch or compress audio playback speed while preserving pitch and harmonics. It includes methods for initialization, buffering, reading, and WSOLA processing, and contains private members for managing audio buffers, processing state, and parameters.

classes.name: AudioTimeStretcher
classes.description: A class that buffers and processes audio data for time stretching using WSOLA, supporting initialization, buffering, reading, and buffer management.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the object with audio stream parameters: sample type, channels, and samples per second.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Attempts to fill requested frames into destination buffer, possibly scaled by playback rate, returning the number of frames copied.

methods.name: EnqueueBuffer
methods.description: Enqueues a decoded audio buffer for processing.

methods.name: IsQueueFull
methods.description: Checks if the internal buffer queue is full.

methods.name: frames_buffered
methods.description: Returns the number of frames currently buffered.

methods.name: GetOptimalBlock
methods.description: Finds the most similar data block within search region for WSOLA processing.

methods.name: WriteCompletedFramesTo
methods.description: Reads a maximum number of frames from WSOLA output into destination.

methods.name: PeekAudioWithZeroPrepend
methods.description: Fills destination with frames from buffer, allowing negative offset with zero padding.

methods.name: RunOneWsolaIteration
methods.description: Performs one iteration of WSOLA overlap-and-add process.

methods.name: RemoveOldInputFrames
methods.description: Advances buffer to remove frames no longer needed.

methods.name: UpdateOutputTime
methods.description: Updates current output time based on playback rate and time change.

methods.name: TargetIsWithinSearchRegion
methods.description: Checks if target block is fully within search region.

methods.name: CanPerformWsola
methods.description: Checks if enough data exists to run WSOLA iteration.

methods.name: ConvertMillisecondsToFrames
methods.description: Converts milliseconds to frame count based on sample rate.
